description: Portable, coordinate-free operations dashboard for one Stash Manager bot or a fleet.

panels.title: Bots online
panels.description: Selected bot APIs currently reachable by Prometheus.

panels.title: Bots selected
panels.description: Number of bots covered by the current dashboard filter.

panels.title: Database connections
panels.description: Selected bots with an active PostgreSQL connection.

panels.title: Indexed containers
panels.description: Containers currently present in the selected bots' indexes.

panels.title: Oldest scan age
panels.description: Age of the stalest latest scan among selected bots.

panels.title: Write health
panels.description: Healthy only when every selected bot's latest persistence attempt succeeded.

panels.title: Scanner state
panels.description: Current scanner state for each selected bot. Paused is a normal task handoff.

panels.title: Scan progress
panels.description: Containers processed from the current scan queue.

panels.title: Scan success
panels.description: Share of processed containers indexed successfully.

panels.title: Failed containers
panels.description: Container targets that exhausted their retry policy.

panels.title: Pending scan work
panels.description: Remaining container targets over time.

panels.title: Scan handoffs
panels.description: Cooperative scanner interruptions during the current or last run.

panels.title: Organizer active
panels.description: Whether each selected bot is organizing now.

panels.title: Organizer progress
panels.description: Completed organizer tasks divided by the current plan.

panels.title: Saved checkpoints
panels.description: Bots with a restart-safe organizer checkpoint on disk.

panels.title: Restart recoveries
panels.description: Bots waiting to resume a checkpoint loaded after restart.

panels.title: Connection recovery
panels.description: Active jobs waiting for their game connection to recover.

panels.title: Proxy control grace
panels.description: Longest remaining client-control grace period among selected bots.

panels.title: Organizer task progress
panels.description: Completed task count over time. A flat active line is worth checking against cooldown and recovery panels.

panels.title: Organizer handoffs
panels.description: Cooperative organizer interruptions in the current or last run.

panels.title: Capacity ready
panels.description: Healthy when every selected bot has a trusted scan and enough permanent or registered staging capacity.

panels.title: Lanes detected
panels.description: Storage lanes detected by the latest scans.

panels.title: Lanes required
panels.description: Dedicated item lanes required by current contents.

panels.title: New lanes to build
panels.description: New dedicated lanes recommended by the construction plan.

panels.title: Lanes to expand
panels.description: Existing lanes that need more double chests.

panels.title: Double chests to add
panels.description: Total double chests recommended across new and expanded lanes.

panels.title: Shulker slot demand
panels.description: Current shulker-slot demand. One double chest holds 54 shulkers; each shulker has 27 item slots.

panels.title: Shulker slots after compaction
panels.description: Projected slot demand after compatible partial shulkers are consolidated.

panels.title: Bulk shulkers
panels.description: Homogeneous boxes ready for dedicated lanes.

panels.title: Mixed shulkers
panels.description: Mixed boxes or returned kits awaiting exact-item separation.

panels.title: Empty shulkers
panels.description: Empty boxes available for reconciliation and packing.

panels.title: Unclassified shulkers
panels.description: Boxes that need a fresh scan before safe organization.

panels.title: Boxes waiting in imports
panels.description: Reconciled boxes temporarily stored in import chests.

panels.title: Permanent lane gaps
panels.description: Exact item classes that still lack a suitable permanent lane.

title: Stash Manager Operations
